components.wording: Explain the purposes and measured variables of pulmonary function testing.
components.assessmentPrompt: Given a set of pulmonary function reports, explain what each test measures and the question it can answer.
components.expectedEvidence: Connect each measurement to its physiological meaning; distinguish measurement from diagnosis.

components.wording: Discuss test quality, limitations and clinical context before interpreting results.
components.assessmentPrompt: Compare an interpretable report with an inadequate-quality report and justify what conclusions can be supported.
components.expectedEvidence: Identify technical limitations, withhold unsupported conclusions and request appropriate information.

components.wording: Interpret pulmonary function findings and justify their clinical meaning.
components.assessmentPrompt: Interpret a new report and discuss relevant alternative patterns using the supplied reference.
components.expectedEvidence: Explain findings, clinical context and uncertainty rather than relying on a single printed value.
